hmong: Kuv pom ib tus poj niam zoo nkauj.
english: I saw a beautiful woman.

hmong: Kuv tsev neeg nyob ze ntawm no.
english: My family lives nearby.

hmong: Muaj tsib leeg tuaj noj mov.
english: Five people came to eat.

hmong: Tus aub hem kuv thaum tsaus ntuj.
english: The dog threatened me at night.

hmong: Ib tus poj niam tab tom taug kev.
english: A woman is walking.

hmong: Muaj ib tus txiv neej nyob ntawd.
english: There is a man over there.

hmong: Kuv tus phooj ywg tuaj xyuas kuv.
english: My friend came to visit me.
note: added the classifier `tus`, as every other `phooj ywg` sentence has

hmong: Peb pab zej zog tu lub tsev.
english: Our community helped clean the house.

hmong: Cov neeg hauv zej sib pab.
english: People in the community help each other.

hmong: Muaj ib tus neeg nyob ntawd.
english: There is a person over there.

hmong: Tus tub hluas nyiam ncaws pob.
english: The young man likes playing soccer.

hmong: Muaj neeg coob hauv lub khw.
english: There are many people in the store.

hmong: Cov menyuam ua si tom tsev.
english: The children are playing at home.

hmong: Tus kws kho mob pab nws.
english: The doctor helped him.

hmong: Cov menyuam yaus ua si nraum zoov.
english: The young children play outside.

hmong: Muaj ib tus mab nyob ze peb.
english: A non-Hmong person lives near us.

hmong: Pejxeem tuaj sib tham ntawm no.
english: The public came to discuss things here.

hmong: Nws muaj xeebceem zoo heev.
english: She has a very good personality.

hmong: Lub pob nyob saum npoo av.
english: The ball is above ground level.

hmong: Muaj ob lub hoob hauv tsev.
english: There are two rooms in the house.

hmong: Peb mus txog qhov kawg lawm.
english: We have reached the end.

hmong: Tus miv nkaum qab lub rooj.
english: The cat hides under the table.

hmong: Nws sawv ntawm sab qhov rooj.
english: She is standing beside the door.

hmong: Kuv nyob tom tsev hnub no.
english: I am at home today.

hmong: Kuv nyob hauv tsev txhua hmo.
english: I stay home every night.

hmong: Lub zos no nyob ze roob.
english: This village is near the mountain.

hmong: Txoj kev no mus rau lub zos.
english: This road goes to the village.

hmong: Lub tsev qub nyob tom ntug zos.
english: The old house is at the village edge.

hmong: Peb nyob ntawm ntug zos.
english: We are at the edge of the village.

hmong: Kuv mus lub khw yuav zaub mov.
english: I go to the store to buy food.

hmong: Peb nyob ze tus dej loj.
english: We live near the big river.

hmong: Kuv xav mus txawv teb chaws.
english: I want to travel abroad.

hmong: Kuv muaj haujlwm ntau hnub no.
english: I have a lot of work today.

hmong: Muaj ntsa siab nyob ntawm no.
english: There is a high wall here.

hmong: Nws sawv ntawm phab tsev.
english: He is standing beside the house.

hmong: Phau ntawv nyob saum rooj.
english: The book is on the table.

hmong: Lub nroog no muaj neeg coob.
english: This city has many people.

hmong: Kuv khaws nyiaj cia txhua hli.
english: I save money every month.

hmong: Nws zaum ntawm ntug txaj.
english: She sits on the edge of the bed.

hmong: Qhov chaw no zoo nkauj heev.
english: This place is very beautiful.

hmong: Qhov no yog kuv qhov chaw.
english: This is my place.

hmong: Muaj ib qho chaw nyob ntawd.
english: There is a place over there.

hmong: Peb mus nyob saum yajsab.
english: We are going to the highlands.

hmong: Peb noj mov ua ke txhua hmo.
english: We eat together every evening.

hmong: Kuv kawm ntawv niaj hnub.
english: I study every day.

hmong: Tos kuv ib nyuag ntu xwb.
english: Wait for me a short while.

hmong: Nws nyob ntawm no ib ntus.
english: She stayed here for a while.

hmong: Kuv nyeem ntawv txhua hmo.
english: I read every night.

hmong: Kuv kuj xav mus nrog nej.
english: I also want to go with you.
